representativeSnapshot.kind: isolated production-like Supabase branch with two organizations and scoped logistics records

rowCountQueries: Count existing team_communications, logistics_tasks, site_map_zones, and each newly promoted logistics table before apply
Inventory existing RLS policies and indexes for every touched table
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: DDL and additive columns only; no existing rows are deleted or rewritten

execution.resumeStrategy: Reapply the idempotent migration in an isolated environment; use a later additive forward migration for any post-apply correction
execution.idempotency: ALTER TABLE/CREATE TABLE/CREATE INDEX use IF EXISTS guards; RLS policy cleanup is repeatable

quarantine.strategy: No data backfill; unresolved legacy rows remain in their source tables

constraints: Positive quantities and valid reservation windows
Status and visibility checks for logistics workflows
indexes: Logistics acknowledgement, reservation, backline, catering, and comms scope indexes
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Apply to a fresh database and a representative legacy snapshot; verify object shape, RLS enablement, absence of broad authenticated policies, and same-organization service-role API behavior

recovery.rollback: Disable the affected Admin logistics surfaces while retaining source and newly created empty tables; never reset a persistent database
recovery.forwardFix: Add corrected columns, policies, or constraints in a later migration and repeat the two-organization authorization matrix

queries: Verify all promoted tables exist with expected columns, indexes, and RLS enabled
Verify no authenticated client policy remains on promoted logistics tables
Run same-organization, cross-organization, revoked, and unauthenticated logistics API checks
